nuggets.text: The Mustangs won their opener at Florida State after a power outage delayed the game nearly two hours.
Nick Reed's 20-yard field goal with 21 seconds left beat Florida State 27-24 in the Mustangs' opener.
Kevin Jennings threw for a career-high 430 yards in the Mustangs' opener at Florida State.
Randy Pittman Jr. caught five passes for 75 yards and a touchdown against his former team, Florida State.
The Mustangs' new recovery center will be named for Kevin Jennings, the first active SMU athlete with a campus space in his name.
Kevin Jennings is in his third straight season as SMU's starting quarterback, a rarity in the transfer portal era.
Peruna, the Mustangs' live black Shetland pony mascot, is named for a patent medicine that was 18 percent alcohol.
A live Peruna pony has been at every SMU home football game since 1932 except one.
Doak Walker won the 1948 Heisman Trophy and remains the only Mustang ever to win it.
Rhett Lashlee once left coaching to co-found a sports magazine, Vype, before returning to the sideline.
